_comment: Reference sources approved for the on-phone guide. Factual sources (cross-references, places, dictionaries, topical index) were approved 2026-11-23 on the coordinator's technical decision. Matthew Henry and Wesley's commentaries were approved 2026-11-23 on Levi's answer A: both are used, each excerpt labelled with author and tradition, and Perazim's own view always comes first. Commentaries ship as an optional download, not in the default install. Creeds: the Nicene-Constantinopolitan Creed of 381 was approved by Levi on 2026-11-23 (his answer A). Its text is in scripts/reference/creeds/, and no database row is built yet, because the creed parser is not written. The other creeds and confessions are NOT listed. Each commentary and factual id must match a sources row in scripts/reference/sources.json.
